name: Glean
summary: Enterprise AI platform that searches company data across connected apps and runs agents.
description: Glean connects to company applications through more than 250 connectors, builds a context layer of enterprise knowledge and permissions, and uses it for search, an assistant and governed agents. Recent releases let developers build, test and publish Glean agents from their coding tools. No public prices are listed; access is through a sales demo. It is aimed at large organisations with many internal systems.

howToUse.title: Ask for access
howToUse.description: Open Glean and request a demo, or sign in if your company already has it. Prices are not listed publicly.

howToUse.title: Connect the company apps
howToUse.description: An admin connects the company applications. Glean keeps each person's permissions on that knowledge.

howToUse.title: Search or ask
howToUse.description: Search across the connected apps, or ask the assistant a question.

howToUse.title: Publish an agent
howToUse.description: From a coding tool, build, test, and publish a Glean agent if the developers use that release.
